note: Bart 11-11: the cast of Babylon and the new farmers (vault topics/babylon-new-farmers/story-map.md). All invented, plausible for the Old Babylonian period.

characters.look: Ana, an 11-year-old girl of a semi-nomadic herding family of the steppe, bright and curious face, a long dark braid, a knee-length plain wool tunic with a fringed wool shawl over one shoulder, a cord belt, bare feet
characters.colours: tunic undyed oatmeal wool, shawl warm madder red-brown with a darker fringe, cord belt dark brown, hair black-brown

characters.look: Hazi, a 13-year-old boy of the same herding family, proud and impatient face, short dark curly hair, a short wool kilt to the knee and a wool cloak tied on one shoulder, a sling tucked in his belt, leather sandals
characters.colours: kilt light brown wool, cloak dark ochre-brown, sling and sandals dark leather brown, hair black

characters.look: Nunu, the grandmother of the family, a stern weathered old woman with deep lines, slightly bent, a long dark wool dress and a heavy shawl over her head and shoulders, a tall wooden staff
characters.colours: dress dark indigo-grey wool, shawl deep brown with a thin red border, staff weathered wood brown, grey hair under the shawl

characters.look: the father, a lean tired hunter in his thirties, short black beard, hair tied back, a knee-length wool tunic, a cloak, a short wooden spear with a stone point, sandals
characters.colours: tunic sand-brown wool, cloak dark olive-brown, spear shaft weathered wood, sandals leather brown, hair and beard black

characters.look: Ilshu, a Babylonian canal inspector in his forties, friendly but tired face, a neatly trimmed dark beard, a round brimless cap, a long fringed tunic of a city man reaching the shins, a cloak, a leather satchel with clay tablets, sandals
characters.colours: tunic pale cream linen with a fringe edged in faded blue, cloak muted blue-grey wool, cap off-white, satchel and sandals warm leather brown, beard black

characters.look: Belessunu, a capable Babylonian woman farmer in her thirties who runs her family field, a long linen dress belted at the waist, a headcloth knotted at the back, sleeves rolled, a curved sickle hanging from her belt, sandals
characters.colours: dress pale undyed linen, belt and headcloth soft ochre, sickle blade dull copper, sandals leather brown, hair dark brown

characters.look: a Babylonian scribe in his fifties, shaven head and clean-shaven face, a plain long linen tunic, holding a small clay tablet and a reed stylus, sandals
characters.colours: tunic plain off-white linen, tablet pale clay, stylus reed straw-colour, sandals light leather brown
